description: Pre-implementation cards derived from the real shadcn-admin research at e16c87f213a5ba5e45964e9b67c792105ec74d26. Claims under test may be deliberately incorrect; these are diagnostic comparisons, not assertions that the project implements them. Expected labels were recorded before reading live answers.

state.user_request: 让 Tasks 页的批量 CSV 导出真正可用，导出的文件要能用于后续整理任务。
state.interpretation: 让用户从 Tasks 的已选任务生成真实 CSV 文件，保留任务身份和完整内容用于继续整理；不把成功通知当成文件交付。

sources: The experiment's original request; export-research.md section 1

state.claim: The current handleBulkExport function generates and initiates downloading a CSV file.
state.excerpt: const handleBulkExport = () => { const selectedTasks = selectedRows.map((row) => row.original as Task); toast.promise(sleep(2000), { loading: 'Exporting tasks...', success: () => { table.resetRowSelection(); return `Exported ${selectedTasks.length} tasks to CSV.`; }, error: 'Error', }); table.resetRowSelection(); }

options.name: Papa Parse 5.7.0
options.verified_fit: Inspected explicit fields/data, quoting, CRLF and custom formula-escape pattern support.
options.tradeoff: Adds a runtime package and TypeScript declarations; the application still owns download and field selection.

options.name: export-to-csv 1.5.0
options.verified_fit: Inspected typed ESM CSV generation, BOM and formula escaping.
options.tradeoff: Needs download URL cleanup and additional formula-text handling.

options.name: Handwritten encoder
options.verified_fit: A custom RFC 4180 encoder can handle the fixed five-string-column format.
options.tradeoff: Avoids a dependency but the project must maintain quoting, special-character and formula edge cases.

state.user_update: 我比较了 Papa Parse、export-to-csv 和手写编码。建议复用 Papa Parse：它的字段控制和字符转义有现成实现与测试，代价是新增一个 CSV 依赖及类型声明；export-to-csv 自带类型、也可用，但仍要补下载清理和文本保护。按钮和表格继续使用项目现有组件。

cases.reason: The draft names the viable custom route but omits its material maintenance cost and dependency tradeoff.

state.claim: The new exporter correctly handles cross-page selection and spreadsheet-formula text.

checks.name: export acceptance plan
checks.observation: Cross-page selection and formula-style input cases have been researched and listed in the plan. Implementation and its tests have not started.
